title: Zesty Bitter Spanish Corn Bowl
description: A festive Valencian-inspired corn arepa bowl filled with airy, dairy-free mozzarella, brightened with a citrusy bitter vinaigrette, served in a stone bowl for authentic texture.
instructions: Mix cornmeal, water, salt, and smoked paprika until a thick batter forms.
Shape batter into 4 small discs and fry in a hot skillet with a splash of olive oil until golden on both sides.
Remove discs and let cool on a rack for a few minutes.
Slice each arepa horizontally and spoon softened vegan mozzarella into the center.
Warm the filled arepas again in the skillet until the cheese melts and edges crisp up.
In a small bowl whisk lime juice, bitter orange zest, sea salt, and olive oil to create a zesty vinaigrette.
Drizzle the vinaigrette over the arepas and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately in a stone bowl for a rustic finish.

axes.primaryIngredient: corn arepa filled with mozarella cheese
